title: Mixed Event — You Are My Hero! — Episode7 The Hero Arrives!

meta.Event Outline: On one of his runs, Tsukasa rescues and befriends a stranded cat. At the same time, a cat-themed carnival has arrived in Shibuya.

rows.Line: In Front of the Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, we've decided to stop and inspect it since it seems to be acting up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: But figuring out the cause may take some time.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hey, it looks like the Ferris wheel is down for repairs...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Aww, I was really looking forward to going on it...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Our hands are tied since we must put safety first...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: That being said... I feel absolutely terrible about disappointing the guests like this during the last day...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
But I'm satisfied.
I started this carnival with the dream of putting smiles on the faces of people all over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This place means everything to Mr. Inuyama...
It's designed to make all those who attend smile and laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And now both he and his guests are going to spend their final day here frowning...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Isn't there a way we can make it so everybody here goes home smiling?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is all I can conjure up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Mr. Inuyama, all of you...
Would you mind listening for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Hey, we wanna go on the Ferris wheel!
When's it gonna be fixed?!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm not sure...
This may take quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: It's too bad, but we'll just have to go on something else. What about that merry-go-round? Doesn't riding cats sound like fun?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We wanna go on the Ferris wheel!

rows.Speaker: Older Cat Sister
rows.Line: “Hehe. So this is the carnival's main attraction. The Ferris wheel. It's the perfect target for a big prank.”

rows.Speaker: Younger Cat Sister
rows.Line: “Yeah, it is. Let's see... Where are the controls...? Let's try checking over there!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: What were they doing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Those girls had really cute cat ears on...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“I have a question for all of you...
Did any of you see a pair of cat sisters pass by here just now?”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wait, is he talking about those girls we just saw...?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Whoa, this cat's wearing a cape...!
That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “The thing is, a pair of mischievous cats have been causing trouble at this carnival recently. I was chasing after them because they're likely up to no good again...”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“But I seem to have lost them.
So, any information that you can provide would be greatly appreciated!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Umm... They went that way!
They even talked about pulling a prank or something!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“What?! That's terrible...!
Thank you, young man!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Oh, is this some sort of event...?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Maybe. I mean, the person we just talked to was totally wearing a superhero costume!

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: “Oh no! But it was moving a second ago. What do you think happened...?”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: “Hey, do you guys know what happened?”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: “Hmm... But the door to the control room is open... Wait, huh?”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line:
“The switch is gone!
No, did those cat sisters steal it...?”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: What...?! The Ferris wheel stopped because of those cat sisters, Mommy...!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wow... So, does that mean it stopping is also a part of this show...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Wow, Tsukasa, that's amazing...!
You turned what happened to the Ferris wheel into part of the show☆)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hmm... Where do you think those cat sisters went?

rows.Speaker: Older Cat Sister
rows.Line: “If you want it back, you'll have to catch us first!”

rows.Speaker: Younger Cat Sister
rows.Line: “But there's no way that's gonna happen.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Hey, cat man!
They're over there!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Hm?! I'll be darned! Thank you, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Stopping the Ferris wheel... How could you do such a thing? I am not letting you two get away this time!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “I, Nyantaro the cat hero, will put an end to your antics! So, freeze!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, he's a cat hero...!
You can do it, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
But the cat sisters are also really cute...!
Run for it, you two!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They've managed to turn the guests' frowns upside down!)

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Ah, I have you now! Give me the switch...”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Grr...! Credit where credit's due, they're working in perfect sync. I've lost them again...”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Do any of you happen to know where those despicable cat sisters went?”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Oh, the little sister's back that way!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“That way...? Ah, underneath the Ferris wheel!
Thank you! I'll take a look now!”

rows.Speaker: Older Cat Sister
rows.Line: “Seriously, why are you being such a pest today?!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“Of course I'm being a pest.
For the sake of the guests waiting to ride the Ferris wheel, I can't afford to give up...!”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: “Hey, everyone, why don't we all show Nyantaro our support?”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: “Our cheers might give him the boost of energy he needs to succeed!”

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line:
“Yeah, you're right!
Let's all cheer for him, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff... They're so fast!
Despite you all cheering me on, I can't seem to catch them...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They should be finished fixing the Ferris wheel soon...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, it looks like they still need more time.
In that case, we can try moving over towards that group of guests and—)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mr. Inuyama's taking down the “Under Repair” sign! That must mean...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The Ferris wheel is ready to run again...!)

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“Alright, playtime is over!
I'm going to catch you two once and for all!”

rows.Speaker: Younger Cat Sister
rows.Line:
“H-He looks really determined...!
Sis, take the switch and...”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Now I just need to flip the switch...”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Th-The Ferris wheel's working again...!
Does this mean we can go on it now...?!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
That was so cool!
Thanks, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah! There's no need to thank me!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: “After all, it's a hero's job to make sure everybody keeps smiling!”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“The memories you make here today...
I hope they make you smile for years to come.”

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line:
“And let me say...
Thank you all for visiting today!”
